title: Federal rules that apply in every state

rules.title: Nonprofit hospitals must have a financial assistance policy
rules.plain: Nonprofit hospitals must have a written financial assistance policy and follow it.
rules.quote: hospital organizations must meet the requirements imposed by Section 501(r) on a facility-by-facility basis

rules.title: Assistance-eligible patients pay no more than insured patients
rules.plain: If you qualify for the hospital's assistance, you can't be charged more than it usually gets from insured patients.
rules.quote: to not more that the amount generally billed (AGB) to individuals who have insurance covering such care

rules.title: Waiting periods before harsh collections
rules.plain: A nonprofit hospital must wait at least 120 days after the first bill before credit reporting, selling the debt or suing, and must accept assistance applications for 240 days.
rules.quote: refrains from initiating such ECAs for at least 120 days

rules.title: Out-of-network emergency care at in-network cost-sharing
rules.plain: For emergency care, your plan can't charge you more than in-network cost-sharing, even at an out-of-network hospital, and you can't be billed for the difference.
rules.quote: the cost-sharing requirement is not greater than the requirement that would apply

rules.title: Self-pay estimate and the $400 dispute
rules.plain: If you're uninsured or self-pay and your bill is at least $400 above the good faith estimate, you may be able to dispute it.
rules.citation: No Surprises Act, patient-provider dispute resolution
rules.quote: You may be able to dispute your bill if it's at least $400 more than the estimate.

rules.title: Medicare patients: free itemized statement within 30 days
rules.plain: If Medicare paid for your care, you can ask in writing for an itemized statement, and the provider has 30 days to send it.
rules.quote: Not later than 30 days after the date on which a request under paragraph (1) has been made
